# Foundations

**This file is complete.** Colour, typography, spacing, radius, elevation and iconography are
all here. Do not conclude something is undocumented without reading to the bottom.

Cite token names, not hex values. The cascade resolves in three layers, last wins:
`src/theme/index.js` → styled-components → `src/static/less/style.less`.

## Typography

Font stacks found in `src/static/less/style.less`:

- `'Lato'`
- `'Droid Arabic Kufi'`
- `Droid Arabic Kufi, sans-serif !important`

Lite / member-area surfaces swap family via `FONT_FAMILY_LITE` = `'Lato, Droid Arabic Kufi, sans-serif'`.

Ant tokens declare Figtree , the LESS layer Lato — both pair with Droid Arabic Kufi for Arabic. Base 14px / line-height 1.571. Lite & marketing surfaces swap family via `FONT_FAMILY_LITE`.

- Weights — `.fw-400 … .fw-900`

## Color

Overridable per tenant/platform at runtime via `getColors()`; below are the Bayut defaults in `themeColors`.

- Primary — Bayut teal
- Semantic & brand
- Neutrals & surfaces
- Data, health & product colors

## Spacing & layout

The scale is the set generated by the utility loops in `utils.less`; layout metrics come from the Layout theme tokens.

- Scale — 0 2 4 8 12 16 20 24 25 30 32 40 48 54

## Radius & elevation

Radius is fixed per component family; there are two shadow recipes plus the raised-button glow.

## Control sizes

Two sets coexist: the LESS `btn-height-*` tokens and the Ant `controlHeight` overrides. Inputs, selects and date pickers share a height scale.

## Iconography

The `<Icon icon="MdEdit" />` atom resolves a string name against four sources in this order : `components/icons.js` (react-icons re-exports) → `components/svg.js` (local product artwork: brand marks, empty-state illustrations, `BayutMatchIcon`) → `widgets/AmenitiesSvg` → `widgets/NewAmenitiesSvg`. Passing `styled` wraps the glyph in the icon container tile. Country flags come from `country-flag-icons` (3×2).

> Product artwork is not drawn in components: illustrations come from `svg.js` exports (`EmptyListing`, `EmptyListingWidget`, `NetworkError`, `NoRecord`) and from `public/profolio-assets/` (188 files — per-tenant favicons and logos, `images/maintenance.svg`, `ph-listings.svg`, `limit-credits.svg`, REGA / ministry badges, `lite/banner-faces.png`). Use those files rather than redrawing.
